service.description: Which company's email server sends the notification for a chat message: the sender's. A message from SystemSupport (or in a GROWERP-owned room) goes out over the SYSTEM server, returned as an empty mailOwnerPartyId; a message from a tenant goes out over that tenant's own server.

parameter.name: mailOwnerPartyId
parameter.description: null for the SYSTEM server, otherwise the owner company

service.description: Email the conversation of one chat room to one of its members, with explanatory text: either they were not there when the message came in, or the conversation has been waiting for their answer for more than 10 minutes. The owner company's own email server is used; only rooms owned by GROWERP (SystemSupport) use the SYSTEM server. At most one email per member per room per 10 minutes. Never returns an error: a chat must not fail because email does not.

parameter.name: reason
parameter.description: offline: the member was not connected when the message came in. noresponse: the member has not answered for more than 10 minutes.

log.message: No email server configured for ${mailOwnerPartyId ?: 'SYSTEM'}, no chat notification sent for room ${chatRoomId}

actions.script:
boolean isVisitor = toUserId == room.visitorUserId // private rooms carry no name: fall back to who wrote last String roomName = room.chatRoomName ?: (latestFirst[0].fromUserFullName ?: 'chat') context.subject = reason == 'noresponse' ? 'Chat waiting for your answer: ' + roomName : 'New chat message: ' + roomName String intro = reason == 'noresponse' ? 'This chat conversation has been waiting for an answer for more than 10 minutes.' : 'A chat message came in while you were not connected.' String closing = isVisitor ? 'You can continue the conversation in the chat window on ' + baseUrl + '.' : 'Log in to the GrowERP app ' + appName + ' to reply' StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder() sb.append('

').append(intro).append('

') sb.append('

The conversation so far:

') for (msg in latestFirst.reverse()) { String when = msg.lastUpdatedStamp ? ec.l10n.format(msg.lastUpdatedStamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') : '' String who = msg.fromUserFullName ?: 'unknown' String text = (msg.content ?: '').replace('&', '&') .replace('<', '<').replace('>', '>').replace('\n', '
') sb.append('

').append(who).append(' ') .append('').append(when) .append('
').append(text).append('

') } sb.append('

').append(closing).append('

') context.bodyHtml = sb.toString()
